prompts.task: Audit ./service read-only for all five concrete AgentDemo modes generic, genai, metrics, logs and none. Inspect app.py, probe.py, README.md and pyproject.toml as actual fixture source. The mode chooses whether the app starts a generic OTel trace pipeline, existing GenAI trace pipeline, real metrics-only SDK, real OTel-logs-only SDK or stdout-only no-instrumentation runtime. Dependencies in the manifest do not make the none mode instrumented. A normal stdout logger is not an OTel LogRecord pipeline. Existing source and public hooks own provider/exporter lifecycle; snapshots or mock HTTP do not prove a live Studio or cloud service. Save and validate canonical .observe/otel-audit.json and .observe/otel.html for generic, plus .observe/mode-audit.json and .md with a separately source-bound assessment of every other mode. No application, dependency, profile, tests or SDK edits. Use only files/terminal, no browser/UI. Do not start the app or receivers, call models/cloud or install packages. For each mode identify actual operation owners and missing operations/content, preserving any active signal stack; generic HTTP telemetry, metrics-only and logs-only are existing instrumentation. The none branch is truly fresh despite shared declared dependencies and remains eligible for the supported AO default. Source-proven existing workflow/model nodes may be enriched only through supported hooks and must not be duplicated, reclassified or replaced. In generic/genai identify missing agent/retrieval/tool nodes and preserve existing workflow/model nodes; in metrics/logs no trace pipeline exists yet, so propose the five actual workflow/agent/retrieval/tool/model operations on an added OTel tracing capability while preserving their active signal provider. Preserve each actual source-backed parent tree. Plan safe useful content using supplied dated typed-message schemas, concrete numeric policy and a named sanitizer before capture/export. Explain error/cancel and no-result semantics from source. Assess optional selected AO project/Agent Stream configuration for existing non-AO modes separately from producer creation, including SDK-free resource resolution and existing native export routing; no AO span-creation dependency or migration is needed. Preserve the custom nondefault signal endpoint(s), harmless existing trace headers, original sinks and all other destinations, and distinguish Studio projectid/logstreamid from public standalone AO projectid/agentstreamid. Routing headers belong only to the trace request; no generic env header leakage or second exporter to the same AO destination. Resource acceptance must include exact reuse, minimal project-before-stream creation, repeats, 409 reconciliation, uncertain create, supplied-ID ownership, ambiguous/auth/transport/server failure, and no speculative creation after failed lookup. All actual startup, sampler/on_start, wire, receiver/cloud, and resource results remain Not proven in this read-only audit. No user library-choice or migration approval question is required. Record the proposed resource-routing dependency closure independently for every mode. In generic/genai, the existing trace pipeline permits resource routing without selecting unrelated missing GenAI operation creation or enrichment. For metrics/logs, name only the actual missing tracing capability and startup prerequisites; resource routing is not permission to select every GenAI gap.

judge_inputs: Inspect real fixture source and all canonical/supplemental saved reports, loaded skill/shared references, actor trace, last_message and grade. Judge concrete per-mode decisions and finding/acceptance bindings rather than copied guardrails or headings.
Return exactly seven ordered checks rubric-1 through rubric-7. This is read-only source assessment: unexecuted runtime remains incomplete; no SDK install or local/cloud startup is expected.
rubric: Classifies generic, genai, metrics and logs as existing instrumentation from their executed source branches, including a real metric SDK or real log bridge/provider even when no GenAI or trace provider exists. Preserves all existing provider/producer/export ownership and introduces no AO span-creation dependency. Classifies none as fresh from its actual stdout-only branch despite shared declared OTel dependencies; never mislabels stdout as native OTel logs or one mode as another mode execution.

Reconciles actual operation boundaries and parentage. Existing generic HTTP/workflow and existing GenAI model spans are preserved and only missing invoke_agent support_agent, retrieval knowledge_base and execute_tool lookup_order plus missing model semantics are proposed through supported hooks for generic/genai. For metrics/logs, adds all five actual operation spans only after adding the missing tracing capability without replacing their active signal provider; each actual operation gets one owner/node. No invented extra workflow, framework bridge suppression, replacement provider, duplicate creator or automatic Galileo/AO migration.

Binds actual known safe inputs/results/model/tool identities, controls and correlation to owning operations with useful typed messages and tool structures, numeric message/part/UTF-8 bounds, named pre-capture sanitizer and exact unavailable reasons. Preserves successful null versus failure/cancel no-result, errors and original business results, and uses the supplied concrete part schemas rather than generic permissive top-level validation to bless malformed known types.

Keeps AO resource setup and runtime-routing as selected executable configuration findings independent of existing producer ownership. Selected existing non-AO cases can resolve project and Agent Stream through supported SDK-free API and route existing OTel spans; no AO SDK or second export to an already configured destination is required. Missing live prerequisites stay precise and incomplete without deleting actionable local work. The per-mode dependency closure demonstrates independent resource-only routing selection for existing trace modes and names only real tracing/startup prerequisites for modes without traces.

Preserves custom nondefault signal endpoints, harmless trace headers, all existing destinations and original logging sinks. Plans trace-specific Studio projectid/logstreamid and separately source-supported public standalone AO projectid/agentstreamid, never both aliases blindly or generic header propagation to metrics/logs. A public hook/API capability gap is exact and operation-scoped, never a reason to migrate the whole stack.

Canonical/supplemental resource acceptance covers reuse with zero creates, ordered minimal creation, mixed state, repeated runs, project/stream 409 exact bounded relookup, uncertain-create reconciliation, lookup-only supplied IDs, wrong-parent and ambiguous/auth/transport/5xx failures without treating failed lookup as absence. Resource resolution, per-request trace binding, protobuf acceptance and real cloud stream receipt remain distinct proof levels.

Produces valid canonical generic audit JSON/HTML and individually addressable per-mode source evidence, findings, dependencies and acceptance; safe content and operations are not closed from producer presence. Clearly states no app/probe/receiver/resource/cloud run occurred, and does not claim Pass/Working/live delivery or mutate source/dependencies/profile to satisfy proposed findings.
